title: Touchline · the story behind the play
text: Missed ten minutes? The score tells you who is ahead. Touchline helps you understand what changed while you were away.

title: One click to a useful example
text: Start with a prepared catch-up. Choose the minutes you missed, and follow either team or an individual player.

title: Start short. Go deeper when useful.
text: Quick gives the main story in plain English. It separates recorded events from a reading of the play, with supporting sources close at hand.

title: Context beyond the statistics panel
text: Tactical adds exact player involvement and before-and-after figures. Here, Ellis usually plays striker but enters on the right wing. The explanation also says when role history was not inspected.

title: Question the commentary
text: Open a claim's sources. Compare activity before and after a change, and see why concurrent events and missing evidence limit the conclusion.

title: Bounded Microsoft Foundry investigation
text: A single Foundry investigator selects evidence tools and follow-up queries. The trace shows what ran. Local checks and writing rules keep the final commentary tied to inspected evidence.

title: Read the connected account
text: Want the longer story? Read a source-linked report of the selected spell or the match so far. It remains optional, with a downloadable text version.

title: Explain this decision
text: An optional decision card connects the recorded incident to a short attributed IFAB quotation and plain-English explanation. Unspecified details stay unspecified; this does not certify the referee's decision.

title: The actual whistle matters
text: The clock includes both halves and added time. Full-time reports unlock at the actual whistle and include late goals, rather than stopping automatically at ninety minutes.

title: Help newcomers understand
text: Glossary languages help with football terms. Formation dots show declared shape, not live player tracking.

title: Reproducible, with honest limits
text: The release includes regression checks, scenario comparisons and retained live failures. All football data is fictional. We do not claim real-match validation or superiority over other systems.

title: Try Touchline 0.6.0
text: Try the public demo linked in our GitHub repository. Catch up, ask what changed, and inspect why. Touchline makes the story behind the play understandable and open to question.
